decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal


1.	The proposal to convert the existing single family dwellinghouse into two three bedroom dwellinghouses does not provide either dwelling with sufficient on-site car parking, which would be likely lead to increased congestion and be detrimental to the free and safe flow of traffic, which is contrary with policy T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

2.	The proposal to convert the existing single family dwellinghouse into two three bedroom dwellinghouses does not provide either dwelling with a private amenity space of a suitable size or shape as per the requirements of Supplementary Planning Guidance, to the detriment of the amenity of both the prospective occupiers of the dwellings and those that surround it.  The proposal would therefore be contrary with policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Conversion of existing single family dwellinghouse into 2 x three bed dwellinghouses.
